## Anas v5.2.14

- 用量仪表切换紧凑／详细模式、语言、宽度或重新显示时复用已有读数；刷新期间也可切换布局，百炼／Qwen 不再因界面操作等待 CLI 查询。首次加载、模型连接变化、定时检查和手动刷新仍正常获取数据。
- 更新存储、插件和中英文升级说明，明确历史重置范围与当前数据格式，精简过时交接记录。配置和数据库格式不变。

- Usage Meter reuses existing readings when changing compact/detailed mode, language, width, or visibility. Layout controls remain responsive during refreshes, and Bailian/Qwen display changes no longer wait for CLI queries. Initial loading, model connection changes, scheduled checks, and manual refreshes still retrieve data.
- Update storage, plugin, and bilingual upgrade documentation, clarify historical reset requirements and current data formats, and remove outdated handoff records. Configuration and database formats are unchanged.
